date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: The September 6 Kabar correspondent explicitly observed small numbers crossing in both directions with passports and no telegram. This supplies an operational easing date, while the ambassador’s September 7 statement retains a different formal effective-day account. Retrospective onset claims of 2000 and 2010 remain unresolved. Contemporary July 2012 reporting already described a special-invitation regime before a separate temporary tightening. An August 12, 2013 Border Service account documents a conditional-admission spell from August 9 at 08:00, with family-event invitations and air-transit exceptions and unrestricted third-country nationals. These earlier observations establish that conditional admission predates 2017 and that qualifying spells exceeded 24 hours; they do not prove uninterrupted identical conditions throughout 2012–2017. The cause of the longstanding regime remains unassigned; the 2013 independence-day explanation is specific to that announced spell.
